Class MutableRandomSelector<T>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.MutableRandomSelector<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the elements
All Implemented Interfaces:
RandomSelector<T>
public final class MutableRandomSelector<T> extends Object implements RandomSelector<T>
A weighted RandomSelector whose elements and weights change: an element is added, removed or given another weight, and selected, in a time that grows with the logarithm of the number of elements. 
var spawns = new MutableRandomSelector<Monster>();
spawns.put(goblin, 10);
spawns.put(dragon, 1);
spawns.next(random);          // a goblin, ten times out of eleven
spawns.put(dragon, 5);        // dragons get more common
spawns.remove(goblin);

For weights that don't change, RandomSelector.weighted(java.util.Map) selects faster. Elements are told apart with equals and hashCode, as the keys of a map are.

Each selection calls RandomGenerator.nextDouble() once. Which element a given number selects isn't specified.

This class is mutable, and isn't safe to use from several threads at once.

Since:
0.2.0
